procedural_matters: Nicolas Tosi (coach of CAN) and Hayley Clark (coach of AUS) attended the hearing as observers, instructions where given on writing.
facts: On the 4th leg of the 1st race both CAN and AUS were on starboard tack on a run.
When AUS was half a boat length to windward and one boat length clear ahead of CAN, AUS gybed to port.
When the distance between them was half a boat length, CAN luffed and passed at a distance of half a meter from the stern of AUS.
If there had not been a change of course by CAN, her leeward bow would have made contact with the quarter of the leeward hull of AUS to a distance of one meter from her stern.
No boat took a penalty in relation to this incident.
There was no contact between the boats.
conclusions: AUS, on port, did not keep clear of CAN on starboard and broke RRS 10.
